title: Upper Musselshell Museum
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Exploring the two Upper Musselshell Museum buildings is like prowling around in someone's attic or barn. Be careful, though. You may run into a full-size replica of a dinosaur skeleton found in nearby Shawmut or a horse drawn hearse with a special passenger!
